import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (top left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='sensor_type', x='price_usd', order=sensor_order, ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Megapixels vs Price scatter (top middle)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                      c=df['model_year'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=30)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price (colored by Year)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Year', fontsize=9)

# 3. 4K video capability by body type (top right)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
video_data = df.groupby('body_type')['has_video_4k'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
video_data['percentage'] = (video_data['sum'] / video_data['count'] * 100).round(1)
video_data = video_data.sort_values('percentage', ascending=True)
bars = ax3.barh(video_data.index, video_data['percentage'], color='coral')
ax3.set_xlabel('% with 4K Video', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('4K Video Capability by Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(video_data['percentage']):
    ax3.text(v + 1, i, f'{v:.0f}%', va='center', fontsize=8)

# 4. Camera count by brand (middle left)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(10)
ax4.barh(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color='steelblue')
ax4.set_xlabel('Number of Models', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Top 10 Brands by Model Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.invert_yaxis()

# 5. Weight vs Megapixels by sensor type (middle center)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax5.scatter(data['weight_grams'], data['megapixels'], alpha=0.5, s=20, label=sensor)
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(fontsize=8, loc='best')

# 6. Average price trend over years (middle right)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
yearly_price = df.groupby('model_year')['price_usd'].mean().sort_index()
ax6.plot(yearly_price.index, yearly_price.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, color='darkgreen', markersize=5)
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Average Camera Price Over Time', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 7. Max ISO distribution (bottom left)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.hist(df['max_iso'], bins=30, color='purple', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Distribution of Max ISO Values', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xscale('log')

# 8. Price by lens mount (bottom middle)
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
mount_price = df.groupby('lens_mount')['price_usd'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
ax8.bar(range(len(mount_price)), mount_price.values, color='teal')
ax8.set_xticks(range(len(mount_price)))
ax8.set_xticklabels(mount_price.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax8.set_ylabel('Median Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Median Price by Lens Mount (Top 8)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Correlation heatmap (bottom right)
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd', 'model_year']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Feature Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xticklabels(ax9.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax9.set_yticklabels(ax9.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Comprehensive Overview', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
